description: This file defines the main API endpoints for a Notes management service using FastAPI. It includes route handlers for health checks, listing, creating, retrieving, updating, and deleting notes, and configures CORS middleware.

classes.name: NotesRepository
classes.description: Repository class managing notes data storage and retrieval.

methods.name: health_check
methods.description: Health check endpoint to verify service is running.

methods.name: create_note
methods.description: Create a new note and return it with Location header.

methods.name: get_note
methods.description: Retrieve a note by its ID.

methods.name: update_note
methods.description: Update fields of a note by its ID.

methods.name: delete_note
methods.description: Delete a note by its ID.
